鬼压床，被恶梦给魇着了？（鬼压床，被恶梦给魇着了？（第22页）身上凉丝丝的，也不热。轻轻按压了一下他的小腹，也没有明显挣脱的痕迹，说明不是肚子痛。那这问题到底出现在了哪里？为何哭得如此撕心裂肺！老夫人心惊，连两位儿科圣手都找不出来症结吗？那不会得了什么大病吧？还是说，被恶梦给魇着了？鬼压床，这一定是鬼压床！当即她就去请裴相爷拿主意：“相爷，要不咱们找人来驱驱邪？不都说小儿容易惊着？咱们衡儿刚经历了一场急疹，真是身子虚弱的时候，没准就让邪气侵体，给魇着了？”此时此刻，裴玄衡的哭声更惨烈了。比杀猪叫还要凄惨。蓝昕薇站在床边都哭成泪人，恨不得替他受苦受罪。裴相爷瞬间苍老了好几岁，叹息了一句：“胡闹！堂堂相爷府，去信那些虚无缥缈的东西？还不得让人笑掉大牙！”“可，可你也不能眼睁睁的看着衡儿，就这么痛苦下去吧……”裴修之也是急得手足无措，抓心挠肺的，嘴上不说，心里也恨不得替儿子去受苦。可偏偏儿子还是个闷葫芦，只一个劲的哭，连根源都找不到。十指连心的痛！这时，苏念禾的脑袋都快要炸了！小公子裴玄衡的话劈头盖脸涌来过来。继而他又挥动着双手双脚。所以小公子现在的状态是，急需要安抚索要抱抱，但他又不知道自己的身体是怎么回事儿？不想要疼痛的感觉。这样的小可怜一哭，就算苏念禾的心是铁石做的，也全都化成了温柔泉……更何况，她是打心眼里喜欢小孩子，根本舍不得他们哭啊！苏念禾几乎是用百米冲刺的速度冲进了屋子：“大少夫人，快抱抱小公子，他非常需要你！”蓝昕薇迟疑地说：“真的？可衡儿又踢又踹的，我根本近不了身，他一定是不想要我这个娘了……”一说到这个，她又委屈地想哭。一直以来都是她亲力亲为带着孩子，可是现在却不要她了？苏念禾连忙摆手：“不是那样的夫人，小公子想要你抱！是真的！”“可，可我一靠近他就哭……”“小公子哭不是因为有人靠近，是高热之后，他的关节酸疼，需要静养几日，便能缓解。不光如此，小公子也正在经历生长痛！近日可是发现小公子抽条了，长高了，体重却一直没有发生变化？”老夫人、蓝昕薇对视了一眼，满脸惊讶。还真是！府里没人比她俩更上心了！几乎隔一天就会称一下衡儿的体重，还真是好久没有长肉了。个子高了，人就显得瘦弱了。但她们还是无法理解苏念禾说的，为什么衡儿想要抱抱，却又要把她们给推开呢？

Chapter 138 The ghost on the bed is haunted by nightmares (page 1)
The ghost lies on the bed and is haunted by nightmares? (Ghost on the bed, haunted by nightmares? (Page 22)) His body was cold and not hot. He pressed his lower abdomen lightly, and there was no obvious sign of breaking away, which meant that it was not a stomachache. So where did the problem come from? Why was he crying so heart-breakingly! The old lady was so frightened that even the two pediatricians couldn't find the crux? Then he couldn't be suffering from a serious illness. Or is she being haunted by a nightmare? It must be a ghost! She immediately went to ask Prime Minister Pei to come up with an idea: "Master, why don't we find someone to exorcise the evil spirits? Don't you think that children are easily frightened? We Heng'er just experienced a rash, and when we are really weak, maybe we let the evil spirit invade our body and be haunted by it?" At this moment, Pei Xuanheng's cry became even more fierce. . Worse than the cry of a pig. Standing beside the bed, Lan Xinwei burst into tears, wishing to suffer for him. Prime Minister Pei instantly aged several years and sighed: "What nonsense! Are you going to believe those illusory things? You can't make people laugh!" "But you can't just watch Heng'er and continue to suffer like this..." Pei Xiuzhi also said He was so anxious that he couldn't help but want to suffer for his son. But his son was still crying, and he couldn't even find the source of the pain! At this time, Su Nianhe's head was about to explode! Then the young master was waving his hands and feet. He was in urgent need of comfort and hugging, but he didn't know what was going on with his body. He didn't want to feel pain. Even if Su Nianhe's heart was made of stone, it would turn into a spring of tenderness... What's more, she loved children from the bottom of her heart and couldn't bear to let them cry! Entering the room: "Madam, please hug the young master, he needs you very much!" Lan Xinwei said hesitantly: "Really? But Heng'er is kicking and kicking, and I can't get close at all. He must not want me as a mother..." When she said this, she felt aggrieved and wanted to cry. She had always been the one to take care of the child, but now she didn't want her anymore? : "Not that kind of madam, the young master wants you to hug him! It's true!" "But, he cries whenever I get close to him..." "The young master is crying not because someone is approaching, but because his joints are sore after a high fever, and he needs to rest for a few days before they can be relieved. Not only that, the young master is also experiencing growing pains! Recently, I found that the young master has had a seizure and has grown taller, but has never lost weight. Has there been any change?" The old lady and Lan Xinwei looked at each other with surprise on their faces. It's true! No one in the house cares more about them than they do! They weigh Heng'er almost every other day. It's been a long time since he has gained weight. He looks thinner when he is taller. But they still can't understand what Su Nianhe said, why does Heng'er want to hug them but push them away?
